verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitHub Projects can be managed through the GraphQL API, but nothing documents a downloadable machine-readable spec such as an OpenAPI file or GraphQL schema. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Having an API is an adjacent capability, not a downloadable spec, and llms.txt and Markdown docs are not API specifications.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
